\markboth{Index}{Index}

Every entry is a hyperlink to the statement's home chapter. \emph{By paper
domain} indexes the book from the corpus side: named statements transcribed
from exemplar papers are grouped under the research area of the source paper,
one entry per line, so each area shows which tools (chapters) its papers
exercise and what they prove. Classical background statements carry no
corpus source and appear only in the alphabetical list below. Full
references appear in each chapter's bibliography.
